_: RxGuard v1.7.0 -- /astaken counts what was taken.
Thirteen of the fifteen new assertions are about behaviour v1.6.0 did not
have, so the reconstructed previous build fails them: it counts every
molecule on the list whether or not it was taken, has no theoretical
section, no if-all-taken figure, no collapsed card and no action marker,
and still prints the POSSIBLY STALE paragraph under each finding.
Two of them (login, the GutLog-down message) guard behaviour v1.6.0
ALREADY had, so a version control cannot make them fail. Each is broken
on purpose in a copy of the current app instead, which is the stronger
control: it shows the assertion responds to the thing it measures.
Note assertion 04 in particular. Asserting 'the burden is RED once a
dose for the untaken medicine exists' would pass on BOTH branches --
v1.6.0 said RED with or without the dose -- and would be worth nothing.
It asserts the PAIR of totals instead, before and after the dose row, so
it can only hold on a build that distinguishes them.

assertions.name: 01 the headline counts 0 RED when nothing red was actually taken
02 a cumulative burden totals only the molecules with a logged dose
03 the if-all-taken figure is kept, labelled, and counted nowhere
04 logging a dose for an untaken medicine moves the as-taken total
05 findings resting only on untaken molecules are moved out of the count
06 one collapsed section names the untaken medicines exactly once
07 the per-finding POSSIBLY STALE block is gone from the page
08 a finding shows severity, title and consequence until it is opened
09 a finding carrying an action says so while still collapsed
10 no burden on this page claims a proposed change it does not have
11 the absence-of-a-flag caveat sits at the page foot
12 the count GutLog's banner reads is the as-taken one
13 the untaken list and the headline both follow the dose log
14 nothing new on this page is typed below 14px
15 the page still refuses to render without a login

mutation.why: take @login_required off /astaken and see the assertion catch it

assertions.name: 16 GutLog being down is still a message, not an exception

mutation.why: replace the unreachable-feed message and see the assertion catch it
mutation.find: return None, "GutLog is not reachable (%s)." % type(e).__name__
